text:
sophie: Heads-up: cross-vendor sync with Nvidia, AMD, and Habana tomorrow 11:00 PT. Focus: finalizing public timeline, thermal headroom for APAC racks, SI test vectors, and marketplace SKU taxonomy. Please surface blockers now.

arjun: I'll bring a condensed perf summary + a CSV mapping kernels->model variants. will note known regressions.

kevin: FYI vendor asked about B200 sustained power in dense racks. request: add a per-rack thermal margin flag for SEA and EMEA.

marta: I'll take marketplace naming and partner PM comms. propose we replace all internal codenames with partner-facing tags (e.g., redwood-gpu-b200 -> RW-B200).

dalia: legal needs the final SKU matrix for export-control review. also need to confirm embargo length: partners asked 72h, ops prefers 48h.

lucas: ops note  we should lock the rollout to two-week slotting per region to avoid overlapping firmware windows.

arjun: quick note: MI300 kernel 1.4.0 shows a 4% perf dip at seq=1024 on our silicon tests. recommend pin to 1.3.x for initial GA images.

sophie: runbook draft (short):

- region_slots: NA: 2026-10-18..2026-10-31, EU: 2026-10-20..2026-11-02, APAC: 2026-10-22..2026-11-05
- target_announce: 2026-11-09T16:00Z (joint vendor call)
- power_headroom_watts: H100: 360, H200: 330, B200: 290, MI300: 460, Gaudi: 210
- thermal_margin: APAC:+12%, EMEA:+8%
- fallback_priority: H100_fp16 -> H200_int8 -> Mi300_fp16 -> Gaudi
- si_deliverables: compatibility_csv, test-images (OCI), harness-instructions

kevin: +1 on thermal_margin. ops wants a flag to auto-adjust batch sizes based on rack temp sensors.

marta: embargo decision? if partners want 72h we need to confirm PR can land within that window.

dalia: legal ok with 48h as default, can extend to 72h for strategic partners only. need approved images + SKU list by Tue COB.

release-bot: action: create branch "announce/gpu-onramp-2026" when SKU list uploaded to /releases/hw.

lucas: SI integrators also asked for a lightweight compatibility matrix for their firmware test harnesses. arjun, can you generate a small CSV (model,kernel,quant,target_hw,notes)?

arjun: yes, will export and link in the meeting notes.

sophie: posting agenda + doc: <https://go/repo/partnerships/hw-roadmap-sync|hw-roadmap-sync>. please attach any last-minute perf traces before the call. :thumbsup: 

marta: adding comms task: coordinate embargo whitelist and partner PR spokespeople.

dalia: noted. I'll start the export-control checklist for MI300 config and flag any restricted SKUs.

sophie: great. see you all tomorrow.
